questions.question: The rheumatoid factor immunoglobulin is against:
questions.explanation: Rheumatoid factor is an autoantibody (IgM) directed against the Fc portion of IgG.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In multiple myeloma which of the following is seen:
questions.explanation: Multiple myeloma causes hypercalcaemia with normal alkaline phosphatase.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Osteoblastic secondaries can arise from:
questions.explanation: Prostate carcinoma gives characteristic osteoblastic (sclerotic) secondaries.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Multiple myeloma is most frequently encountered in the .......decade:
questions.explanation: Multiple myeloma is mainly a disease of older adults, peaking around the seventh decade.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following blood groups is called universal donor:
questions.explanation: Group O is the universal donor for red cells.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/A. K. Jain/3rd Ed./Pg. 115

questions.question: Hyperbaric oxygen is indicated in:
questions.explanation: Hyperbaric oxygen is indicated in anaerobic infections such as gas gangrene.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/A. K. Jain/3rd Ed./Pg. 491

questions.question: Most commonly the isolated organism from domestic animal bite is:
questions.explanation: Pasteurella multocida is the commonest organism isolated from dog and cat bites.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Three types of polio virus isolated are:
questions.explanation: The three poliovirus types are Brunhilde (type 1), Lansing (type 2) and Leon (type 3).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A laboratory report indicates that a patient's hematocrit and hemoglobin levels are decreased when compared to expected values. Which condition would not typically be associated with decreased hematocrit and hemoglobin levels?
questions.explanation: Hypoglycaemia is not associated with low haemoglobin and haematocrit; anaemia, iron deficiency and blood loss from trauma are.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter:
Cited reference: Neurology and Neurosurgery Illustrated/

Medicine/Davidson/20th Ed./Pg. 823

questions.question: HLA B 27 is negative in ________.
questions.explanation: HLA-B27 is associated with ankylosing spondylitis, Reiter syndrome and psoriatic spondyloarthropathy but not with SLE.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Wilson's disease is ___________.

options.B: Caused by disturbance of copper metabolism

questions.explanation: Wilson disease is an inherited disorder of copper metabolism causing hepatolenticular degeneration.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Commonest embolus originates from:
questions.explanation: Deep vein thrombosis is the commonest source of emboli (pulmonary thromboembolism).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: You are studying diabetes mellitus and diabetes insipidus in your clinical pathology course. Which of the following statements is not true about diabetes mellitus, but best describes diabetes insipidus?

options.A: It is a disorder of carbohydrate metabolism
options.C: It is associated with the pancreas
options.D: It is associated with the pituitary gland

questions.explanation: Diabetes insipidus results from ADH deficiency (pituitary), unlike diabetes mellitus, which involves pancreatic insulin.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Human Physiology/A. K. Jain/1st Ed./Pg. 258

questions.question: In clinical pathology class, the professor describes a pathological disease that involves the arteries and veins of the lower extremity. The symptoms are inflammation, venous thrombosis, and ischemia of the feet. Which of the following diseases is being described by the professor?
questions.explanation: Thromboangiitis obliterans (Buerger disease) is inflammation with thrombosis of small and medium arteries and veins of the limbs, with ischaemia of the feet.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Skin from uniovular twin having common placenta is also accepted, which is called?
questions.explanation: A graft between genetically identical individuals (identical twins) is an isograft (syngeneic graft).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: K.M. Varghese Company/Tidy's Physiotherapy/ 12th Ed./Pg. 310

questions.question: Serum uric acid level is higher in _______.
questions.explanation: Hyperuricaemia is the hallmark of gout.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: K. M. Varghese Company/Tidy's Physiotherapy/ 12th Ed.Pg. 144

questions.question: The best technique to demonstrate the orientation of collagen fibers within bone:
questions.explanation: Polarized light shows the orientation of collagen fibres in lamellar bone.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 53

questions.question: The cause of rheumatoid arthritis is:
questions.explanation: Rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune (immunological) disease.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In rheumatic arthritis the pathology starts in:
questions.explanation: Pathology in rheumatoid arthritis begins in the synovium.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
